verdict.rationale: RudderStack is warehouse-native. It loads all event data into the customer's own warehouse under a predefined schema and says it stores data on the customer's infrastructure, so the data stays in customer-controlled, standard tables. Profiles are also defined in version-controlled YAML that generates warehouse-native SQL, and a self-hostable open-source version exists. However, nothing documents a dedicated export or offboarding path for all account data, such as configurations, tracking plans and transformations, in open formats. missing for 10: explicit full-account export/offboarding feature, documented open export formats for workspace configuration, independent hands-on corroboration of leaving with all data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
